title: AUT CISRC Authority Chain
description: Profile-specific schema for representing an authority chain in the AUT CISRC implementation profile. This schema is non-normative and does not modify SILT Core v0.1.

rootAuthority.description: The originating source of authority, such as Act, statute, charter, or institutional governance instrument.

governanceDomain.description: The domain over which the authority chain applies.

class.description: The type of authority node, such as UniversityCouncil, ViceChancellor, Dean, Supervisor, EthicsCommittee, or ResearchAdministrationUnit.

object.description: The specific instance of the authority node.

level.description: Numeric hierarchy level. Lower numbers indicate higher-order authority.

parentNodeId.description: Optional reference to the parent authority node.

authorityDomain.description: Domains over which this authority node has standing.

evidenceDocuments.description: Documents supporting the authority chain as a whole.
